recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The main search page already describes the behavior, and this closes the remaining parallel terminology-definition gap. Future work should only revisit this if FHIR-I wants computable constraints for which reference SearchParameters support hierarchical `:contains`.
issue_request: FHIR-40792 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from FHIR-I to define `:contains` for hierarchical searches, so a single query can retrieve the selected node plus ancestors and descendants.
initial_application: PR 3967 was represented locally by commit f41c8ea93f5763d8335d679863f9a3fc45dde6db, which updated `source/search.html` to allow `contains` on reference search parameters, describe the hierarchy behavior, and add a Task `part-of:contains` example. That application did not update the active `search-modifier-code` CodeSystem concept definition.
additional_context: FHIR-36684 was the earlier published modifier clarification that documented the pre-FHIR-40792 string/uri `contains` baseline. FHIR-I Confluence minutes recorded the April 2023 plan to start a Zulip thread and the May 2023 WGM conclusion that further Zulip discussion was unnecessary before the Persuasive vote; no directly relevant Zulip issue-key hits were found.
reconciliation: Updated `source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml` so the `contains` concept definition covers containment tests in fields and in supported hierarchical relationship trees. Also corrected the adjacent `hierarchial` typo in the `source/search.html` modifier summary.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml: broadened the `contains` CodeSystem definition to include supported hierarchical relationship trees as well as field containment.
source/search.html: corrected the `hierarchial` typo in the `contains` modifier summary row.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published search-modifier clarification established the string/uri baseline that FHIR-40792 later extended to reference hierarchies.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to define `:contains` for hierarchical searches, voted 6-0-0 and applied for R6.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final work-group decision requiring current R6 source to define hierarchical `:contains` behavior.

evidence_items.summary: Commit `FHIR-40792 - Add contains modifier for hierarchical searches` updated `source/search.html` with reference modifier semantics and a Task hierarchy example.
evidence_items.learned: The primary application was present, but the commit did not update the active modifier CodeSystem definition.

evidence_items.summary: The search page lists `contains` for reference parameters and explains that it returns the selected resource with ancestors and descendants for supported hierarchies.
evidence_items.learned: The page-level semantics satisfy the Jira request and provide the target behavior for the parallel terminology definition.

evidence_items.summary: Before reconciliation, the `contains` CodeSystem concept still defined only matching anywhere within the field being searched.
evidence_items.learned: This active terminology definition was inconsistent with the applied hierarchical reference semantics and needed a source fix.

evidence_items.summary: The active `search-modifier-code` ValueSet entry points to the searchparameter terminology source.
evidence_items.learned: The edited CodeSystem/ValueSet family is in current build scope rather than a stale generated artifact.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes first recorded that a Zulip thread would be started, then recorded that further reflection made the thread unnecessary and the issue was Persuasive.
evidence_items.learned: The minutes support the Jira disposition and do not add a narrower source scope.
